svg.text: ap-south-1 · pin AZ IDs (aps1-az1…), never the names — 'ap-south-1a' is a different physical zone in each AWS account
regional services — there is nothing to place
prod only · uat: subnets, no paid capacity
A regional service has no zone to choose.
Only the six resources below need one.
MUST be a different AZ from the writer
assert it in IaC — do not assume
a cost call: each EIP is one more to allowlist
The only asymmetry that matters: the writer is in ONE zone. Everything else is spread, and the spread is asserted, not hoped for.
